fullContentText: Product & Supply Industrial Valves Drilling Equipment Maintenance, Repair Tools Rotary Equipment Pumps Process Equipment Instrumentation Electrical & Power Transmission Maintenance, Repair & Operation Tools Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers HVAC & Refrigeration Heavy Plant Machinery & Vehicles Safety Products Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers _ Industrial oils, chemicals, and lubricants play a critical role in the process industry. Industrial oils are used in a wide range of machinery and vehicles, available in various types such as gear oils, air compressor oils, hydraulic oils, rock drill oils, turbine oils, and low-toxicity oils. Chemicals are often blended to enhance fuel efficiency and protect equipment from corrosion, contributing to improved performance and longevity. Lubricants are essential for minimizing friction between moving surfaces—particularly in rotary equipment—ensuring smooth and efficient machinery operation. Commonly used lubricants include motor oils, marine oils, silicone-based lubricants, greases, turbine oils, metalworking fluids, cutting and grinding fluids, farming oils, gas engine oils, brake fluids, and hydraulic oils. Lubricating Grease Lubricating grease is a semi-solid lubricant made by blending mineral oil with a soap-based thickener. Unlike liquid lubricants, it doesn't flow easily, which allows it to cling effectively to moving parts. Its consistency makes it easy to apply, provides excellent sealing capabilities, and ensures long-lasting performance. Due to its reliability and versatility, lubricating grease is widely used across industries such as construction, agriculture, oil and gas, and chemical processing. Grease Gun OFS offers a comprehensive selection of grease guns designed for professional lubrication applications. Our range includes: Lever-operated models for heavy-duty use Pistol grip designs for enhanced control Hand grip options for precision applications We understand that proper lubrication requires the right tools. That's why our grease guns are engineered to deliver precise amounts of lubrication - typically 1-3 grams per stroke - ensuring optimal performance while minimizing waste. fullContentText: Product & Supply Industrial Valves Drilling Equipment Maintenance, Repair Tools Rotary Equipment Pumps Process Equipment Instrumentation Electrical & Power Transmission Maintenance, Repair & Operation Tools Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers HVAC & Refrigeration Heavy Plant Machinery & Vehicles Safety Products Industrial Valves _ Industrial valves play a crucial role across all sectors of the manufacturing industry, particularly in oil and gas, chemical processing, and water management systems. At Refteck, we supply a wide range of industrial valves designed to handle various pressure levels and flow requirements. Our valves are suitable for controlling the movement of gases, liquids, and semi-solids, offering reliable solutions for diverse industrial applications. Ball Valve A ball valve by OFS is designed to regulate the flow of liquids and gases efficiently. It is available in various body constructions, including one-piece, two-piece, three-piece, and flanged designs. Known for its quick operation, the valve only requires a quarter-turn of the actuator, allowing for instant on/off control. OFS ball valves are built for long-term durability, crafted from robust materials to ensure reliable performance even under demanding conditions. Gate Valve One of the most widely used valves across industries, the OFS gate valve serves as a reliable on/off switch to start or stop fluid flow. We provide a diverse range of gate valves, including screwed, union, bolted-bonnet, welded-bonnet, and pressure-seal designs. Operating the valve is simple—turning the wheel raises or lowers the gate, controlling the flow of liquids and gases. While it can assist in fluid regulation, its primary function is to either fully open or completely shut off the flow, making it ideal for isolation applications. OFS gate valves are engineered for durability and precision, ensuring optimal performance in demanding environments. Butterfly Valve OFS provides a versatile range of butterfly valves designed for various applications, including chemical processing, HVAC systems, water distribution, agriculture, and heavy industrial plants. These valves feature a compact, rotating circular disk that efficiently regulates flow while maintaining a low-profile design—ideal for installations in tight or confined spaces. Engineered for reliability and ease of operation, OFS butterfly valves ensure precise flow control with minimal pressure drop. Their lightweight yet durable construction makes them a cost-effective solution for both on/off and throttling applications across multiple industries. Globe Valve The OFS globe valve delivers precise flow control in pipelines, offering superior shut-off and throttling performance. Unlike ball valves, its unique design allows for fine-tuned regulation, making it ideal for applications requiring accurate flow adjustment. Engineered for reliability and ease of maintenance, OFS globe valves are commonly used in: Fuel oil systems Cooling water circuits Turbine seals and vents Plug Valve OFS plug valves deliver reliable quarter-turn operation for instant, leak-proof flow control in demanding applications. Combining the quick action of ball valves with enhanced durability, these valves excel in petroleum pipelines, chemical plants, and industrial fluid systems. Engineered for critical service, OFS plug valves maintain bubble-tight shutoff and smooth performance under high pressures while optimizing flow capacity. Check Valve The OFS check valve is an essential one-way valve designed to prevent backflow and protect equipment from damage. fullContentText: Product & Supply Industrial Valves Drilling Equipment Maintenance, Repair Tools Rotary Equipment Pumps Process Equipment Instrumentation Electrical & Power Transmission Maintenance, Repair & Operation Tools Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers HVAC & Refrigeration Heavy Plant Machinery & Vehicles Safety Products Rotary Equipment Supplier _ Rotary equipment refers to mechanical systems that generate kinetic energy to enable movement within industrial operations. Common across the process industry, this category includes devices that move solids, liquids, or gases via a combination of drivers, driven components, and transmission mechanisms. Rotating equipment is integral to operations involving steam and gas turbines. In such applications, steam turbines act as primary drivers—using high-pressure steam to power equipment like forced or induced-draft fans, pumps, and air compressors. Gas turbines, on the other hand, can either drive generators directly through compressed air or use “scoop tubes” in fluid couplings to transmit energy to rotating components. Due to the high speeds and pressures involved, operating rotary equipment can pose significant risks. Therefore, strict adherence to safety procedures and regular maintenance are critical to ensure safe and efficient performance. At OFS , we supply high-quality rotary equipment and components built to meet the rigorous demands of industrial environments—ensuring reliability, performance, and safety in every application.
